classification.difficultyReason: Interpret a practical composite shape, derive the semicircle radius and subtract both components of the opening.

inlines.text: Tui has a wall that has a height of 3.5 m and width of 6.5 m.
She has cut an arch into the wall that consists of a semicircle with a diameter of 3.5 m and a rectangle that is 1.75 m high.
Calculate the area of the wall she has left, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 10 diagram, below the prompt on the left
spec.description: A rectangular wall with a central arch opening extending from its bottom edge. The opening consists of a rectangle topped by a semicircle tangent to the wall's top edge. Light green identifies the remaining wall; the opening remains white.
spec.mathematics: Wall dimensions are 6.5 m by 3.5 m. The opening is 3.5 m wide, with a rectangular height of 1.75 m and a semicircle of radius 1.75 m. All four source dimension labels and their aligned endpoints are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimension labels and region shading are permanent question givens. No calculated area is shown.
